title: Accounts no longer provide a `keys` field. Platforms should use their own API key to authenticate as their connected accounts
summary: Renames the keys property for account creation. Platforms should now authenticate as their connected accounts with their own key through the Stripe-Account header.

migrationNotes.text: This change removes the keys property from account creation and introduces a new authentication method for platforms to act on behalf of connected accounts. You must now use your own key with the Stripe-Account header to authenticate as connected accounts.

Renames the `keys` property for account creation. Platforms should now authenticate as their connected accounts with their own key through the [Stripe-Account header](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/authentication.md#stripe-account-header).
